column1: # The module baseline's build times, read by scripts/module-report.mjs when it is run without --timings
# (scripts/fast.sh passes the run's own ledger instead). Columns: kind, name, milliseconds, note.
# Measured on avell (this node), 2026-11-18, cargo 1.100.0 (release profile,
# (113 s), then each crate's own .rs files touched and 'cargo build --release -p <crate>' timed, so the
# number is that crate's own rebuild - the metric ARCHITECTURE.md's split threshold names - and not a
# cold dependency graph. The note says how many units the compiler built; there is no 0-unit row here.
# The nested fixture packages and the 25 WASM components are not in this pass: a component is built for
# wasm32 by scripts/build-components.sh under components.lock pins, and the fast path times it when it
# builds one for a row. The report prints '-' for both - an unmeasured module is not a fast one.
# Rows whose first measurement waited on a concurrent build's target-directory lock were re-measured on a
# quiet tree before being written here (wa-mesh read 160 s under the lock and 4.5 s alone).
